descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S08 「打字问自定义问题——养老院体重」 Typed custom question — Nursing Home weight

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 A typed custom question is answered correctly.（UAT TC-15；TFA-92593 AC 5）
  • U4 Answers are grounded only in that patient's data: no cross-patient bleed, no invented information, no outside data; per 3.4 no guessed units on ambiguous values and no narration of documentation stat …（UAT TC-15；TFA-92593 AC 3；UAT 3.4）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given NH resident with weight in vitals

When Type "What is her current weight?"

Then Answer quotes the stored weight with its stored unit

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：'61.4 kg' (or '61.4kg') present; no lb conversion, no invented trend (U4)

在哪跑：dev 单元 U41；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S08 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-15.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。

UAT item: TC-15 Ask AI · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-15/S08

Typed custom question — Nursing Home weight

Tickets: TFA-92593 Ask AI (ready for qa)

Result: Pass from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (units/U41.verdict.json), unit U41 split by its parts' checkpoints. Agent: 101 turns, 653 s, $0.88.

Plan: unit U41 (#41, ready-for-qa, live AI (Save Note / Save & Extract / Ask AI)) — Pre-Round Ask: meds, weight, temperature units. Same sheet, one question per chart, read-only. The seeds do not overlap (Okafor-meds, Brooks-vitals, and S16's six temperature charts), so one union seed with the original keys serves all three; the reads are per-chart gets at each checkpoint. Runs together with TC-15/S12, TC-15/S16.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #41, U41; checked: yes): Fail → needs Preston (cluster U: unit guessing) — bare stored temp '60' → Ask AI answers '60°F (or 60 degrees as documented)' (flags it as implausible but still adds °F). Bare 37.9 → °C and 100.4 → °F were accepted by the case (clinically unambiguous). Same class as U38 → GK11. Other 6 checkpoints pass (meds answer, weight kept in kg, temps with units kept)
